_about: Domestic tariff schedules. 'confidence' says how far to trust each one: 'official' = read from the SRO/NEPRA document itself; 'secondary' = reported by news/explainer sites; 'observed' = inferred from rates printed on real bills (only the bands those bills used are known). The auditor never tells a user their bill is wrong based on a 'secondary' rate without saying so.

schedules.source: IESCO Mar-2023 bill: 25.53 x 393 (unprotected, no slab benefit)
S.R.O. 279(I)/2026 as reported by ebillpakistan.pk; fixed charges corroborated by Express Tribune (11-Feb-2026)
schedules.caveat: Per-unit rates equal NEPRA's July-2025 decision (Pakistan Observer), yet Tribune reports Feb-2026 per-unit cuts of Rs 0.49-1.53. Unverified until the SRO itself is read.
